caption: The drawing features a single dark brown or black leather shoe, depicted in a detailed, realistic style, positioned horizontally with the toe pointing towards the left side of the image. The shoe has visible creases and a slight shine on its surface, with a low heel and a rounded toe. It is laced with tan-colored shoelaces tied in a simple bow. To the upper left of the shoe, there are two lightly sketched outlines of shoes, drawn side by side in a less detailed, almost diagrammatic style; the left sketch includes a bow at the toe, while the right sketch is plain. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, giving a clean, off-white backdrop that emphasizes the shoe and the two sketches.
title: Shoe
